title: The Mason's Ledger
goalText: Title the ledger, strike every wall, pay the crew, fix Kit's and Bram's names, cut Mira's note, and add a door at the end.

scripts.title: The Mason's ledger
scripts.goalText: Title the ledger, strike every wall, pay the crew, fix Kit's and Bram's names, cut Mira's note, and add a door at the end.
startLines: Mira ....... unpaid  (owed since the Last Saving)
hints: `i` types before the cursor and `A` at the end of the row: the title needs both. `Esc` stops typing.
Press `dd` on a wall row to strike it. `.` repeats a change.
`a` types after the cursor: on the K of Kt, `ai` makes Kit. On the e of Brem, `r` then `a` makes Bram.
Cursor on the u of unpaid, press `2x`. Then `j` and `.` for each row below.
On Mira's row, cursor just after paid. `D` cuts the rest of the row; `2D` takes the wall row below too. Last, `o` opens a row below: type door, then `Esc`.
